description:
Peaceful Music | Veena Instrumental for Evening Wind-Down | 1.5 Hours

For Saturday evenings when the week is done and you want to actually rest — this is your soundtrack.

90 minutes of slow, contemplative Veena (the ancient long-necked lute of South India, deep resonant character) designed to help you settle into weekend calm.

What you'll hear:
• Slow Hindustani Veena — sustained resonant plucked-string phrasing
• Soft tanpura drone beneath
• Recorded warm and acoustic, no electronic processing
• Long sustained phrases with breath between

Best for:
• Saturday evening decompression
• Post-workweek unwinding
• Meditation and reflection
• Reading, journaling, quiet time
• Winding down before Sunday morning

Dim the lights. Press play. Let the week go.
